headline: Should Henry Schein’s Raised 2026 Sales Growth Guidance Require Action From Henry Schein (HSIC) Investors?
summary: Henry Schein, Inc. reported past Q2 2026 results with sales rising to US$3,458 million and net income to US$94 million, alongside higher basic and diluted earnings per share from continuing operations versus a year earlier. Importantly for long-term watchers, management also raised its 2026 total sales growth guidance, signaling greater confidence in the company’s operating initiatives and demand trends.
